content: Nyakasane abulagira Mûka wâge oku bantu boshi
«Enyuma ly’aho, nâdubulirakwo ngasi muntu Omûka gwâni. Bagala binyu na bâli binyu bakaz’ilêba, abashosi binyu bakaz’ilôrha ebyâbà, n’emisole yinyu ekaz’ibonekerwa.
“Mw’ezo nsiku, ciru n’abajà n’abajà-kazi, nâbadubulirakwo Mûka gwâni”.
emalunga n’en’igulu, mukò, muliro n’ecitù c’o­mugî”.
“Izûba lyâshuba mwizizi, n’omwêzi guhinduke nka mukò, embere Olusiku lwa Nyakasane luyishe, Lusiku luhamu lwa kujugumya!”
“Ngasi yêshi wâshenge izîno lya Nyakasane, oyo ye wananafulumuke. Nk’oku Nyakasane aderhaga, oku ntondo ya Siyoni kwabà abafulumusire, n’aha Yeruzalemu habà abà Nyakasane ahamagalire

footnotes.text: 3, 3 Birhangâzo: cimanyîso ca kuderha oku Nyamuzinda ayishitwa olubanja luzinda, amango g’Olusiku lwâge, lolà 1, 15; 2, 1-2.10; Amo 8, 9

3, 5 -ahamagalîre okulama: abafulumusire olufù bahâhwa okulamira aha Yeruzalemu, kwo kuderha bahâbwa akalamo kinjà. -Mashanja: Nyamuzinda ashub’iyûbaka Israheli, ci amashanja galibuzize Israheli gahanwa, lolà Abu 15-21.
